C17 is an earlier instance of the same template; C05 shares only a more generic congressional-transmission form.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"I am presenting herewith a Midyear Economic Report to the Congress. This is supplementary to the Economic Report of the President of January 6, 1950, and is transmitted in accordance with section 3 (b) of the Employment Act of 1946.","parent_excerpt":"I am presenting herewith a Midyear Economic Report to the Congress. This is supplementary to the Economic Report of the President of January 7, 1949, and is transmitted in accordance with section 3 (b) of the Employment Act of 1946.","explanation":"The principal transmission paragraph is copied almost verbatim, with only the annual date changed."},{"child_excerpt":"In preparing this report, I have had the advice and assistance of the Council of Economic Advisers, members of the Cabinet, and heads of independent agencies.","parent_excerpt":"In preparing this report I have had the advice and assistance of the Council of Economic Advisers, members of the Cabinet, and heads of independent agencies.","explanation":"This consultation clause is substantively identical."},{"child_excerpt":"Together with this report, I am transmitting a report, The Economic Situation at Midyear 1950, prepared for me by the Council of Economic Advisers in accordance with section 4 (c) (2) of the Employment Act of 1946.","parent_excerpt":"Together with this report I am transmitting a report, the Economic Situation at Midyear 1949, prepared for me by the Council of Economic Advisers in accordance with section 4 (c) (2) of the Employment Act of 1946.","explanation":"The concluding operative paragraph preserves the same wording, agency, statutory authority, and placement, changing only the report year."}]}
